**About The Role**
 MyPay is Chime’s Earned Wage Access (EWA) product and one of the company’s fastest\-growing, revenue\-driving products, used by millions of members to access their earnings when they need it.
   

  

 We power complex, real\-time money movement at scale \- including underwriting, eligibility decisions, ledgering, and seamless financial transactions.
   

  

 In this role, you will design and build backend services where correctness, resiliency, and performance are critical. You will collaborate closely with Product, Design, Data Science, Risk, Analytics, and others to drive rapid experiments, make data\-driven decisions and scale high\-impact solutions.
   

  

 The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $133,000 and up to $184,000\. **In this role, you can expect to**
* Independently own and deliver features end\-to\-end
* Design, develop, test, refactor and scale backend implementations of new and existing consumer product features
* Work with the mobile team to design and build strong, resilient APIs that power the member facing mobile app
* Collaborate with cross functional teams to understand member pain points and come up with solutions
* Proactively identify opportunities for improving the reliability and scalability of our systems
* Work across the engineering team to improve and uphold high technical standards
* Grow into owning larger components of the system over time


**To thrive in this role, you have**
* 3\+ years developing software in a production environment at scale
* Experience designing APIs, working with transactional databases and caching systems
* Exposure to architectural patterns of large, high\-scale web applications
* An appreciation of maintainable and well\-tested code
* Enjoyment in learning and diving into the deepest levels of how things work
* Collaborative spirit and strong communication skills, with experience working cross\-functionally
* Product mindset with a strong bias toward experimentation, iteration, and measuring impact
* Start\-up experience as an added plus
